# CIP catalog

The codes the `cip` package names, generated from [cip/catalog.json](cip/catalog.json)
and [cip/vendors.json](cip/vendors.json). Codes marked *vendor* are Rockwell
Automation extensions, not part of CIP; the `logix` package uses them.

## Provenance

The ODVA specifications are sold by ODVA and are not redistributed here. Every
code below is a fact published in at least the source named in its row:

| Source | Reference |
|---|---|
| `edspie` | eds_pie (MIT): references/ethernetip_lib.json (object class codes) |
| `odva` | ODVA, The CIP Networks Library, Volume 1 (CIP) and Volume 2 (EtherNet/IP adaptation): code assignments as reproduced in the public implementations below; the specifications are sold by ODVA and not redistributed |
| `opener` | OpENer (EIPStackGroup), adapted BSD licence: source/src/cip/ciptypes.h, cipconnectionmanager.h, ciperror.h |
| `pycomm3` | pycomm3 1.2.16 (MIT): pycomm3/cip/status_info.py, object_library.py, data_types.py |
| `rockwell` | Rockwell Automation, Logix 5000 Controllers Data Access (1756-PM020), public |

## Vendors

1463 vendor IDs, from ODVA's public vendor list as pycomm3 1.2.16 carries it
(see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)); `cip.VendorName(id)` looks them up.
